title: Broadway in North Beach, at Columbus Avenue, San Francisco
description: Night city street with bright neon signs for Condor and Big Al’s Nude Girls, a car in foreground under a dark sky with blurred lights. The panel under her looks like it reads “CAROL DODA TOPLESS,” with “LOVE ACT” below that. Taken near the end of Doda’s run. She kept dancing topless at the Condor until 1985. It was also about nine months after the club’s most notorious night: a bizarre death at the Condor in November 1983, when a bouncer was killed on the hydraulic piano that Doda famously rode down from the ceiling. The original club closed in 2000. That means the gangster is still up there today, while the Doda sign is gone. Possibly taken from a moving car.
